releaseTitle: ATalk v3.11.3 — Dedicated Profile Screen & Bottom Tab, 10 Distinct Theme Vibes & Hand-Crafted Classic Wallpapers
releaseNotes:
• 01 Dedicated Profile Screen & Rightmost Bottom Dock Tab: Added dedicated Profile tab [Chats, Status, Calls, Profile] at the rightmost position. All profile management (avatar editor, name, handle, bio, linked phone & email, QR code sharing, cryptographic fingerprint) is now exclusively located in the dedicated Profile screen.
• 02 Settings Isolated to System Preferences & Security: Completely removed profile cards and profile editing sheets from Settings, making Settings purely focused on app preferences, themes, security, backups, and storage.
• 03 10 Distinct Theme Palettes & Vibes: Replaced overlapping dark/purple variants with 10 completely unique color temperatures and vibes: OLED Midnight, Kyoto Forest, Sahara Terracotta, Nordic Glacier, Cyberpunk Neon, Rose Twilight, Carbon Noir Titanium, Imperial Gold, Crimson Dynasty, and Deep Cobalt.
• 04 Hand-Crafted Classic Wallpapers: Completely replaced simple math grids and bare sine waves with 8 rich, detailed vector illustrative patterns: Telegram-style Messenger Doodles, Japanese Ukiyo-e Wave Crests, Botanical Monstera & Fern Canopy, Celestial Astrolabe & Lunar Horology, Art Deco Gatsby Fan Arches, Antique Nautical Charts, Steampunk Clockwork Gears, and Metropolis Architectural Blueprints.
• 05 Full Edge-to-Edge Continuity: Maintained full immersive wallpaper rendering and synchronized styling across all root tabs and conversation rooms.
